title: Copper Hearts
body:
![Copper Heart](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/32cd31086758ceeb2c18a552ed6159f2129a45ae.png)
This Mod adds Copper Hearts to your Minecraft World that give you 4 extra hearts when used for 2 minutes.

Copper Hearts can only be stacked up to 1 in a single inventory slot.

Craft Copper Hearts with 4 Copper Blocks and 1 Redstone Block in the middle.![Copper Heart](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/32cd31086758ceeb2c18a552ed6159f2129a45ae.png)
